message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "AbstractUnArchiver", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "The method extractFile in AbstractUnArchiver receives an entryName parameter that is derived from archive entry names (a configured source) and uses it directly to construct a file path via FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName). This path is then used as the first argument to new FileOutputStream(f) (a configured sink) without adequate sanitization or containment checks to prevent path traversal attacks, as the entryName can contain directory traversal sequences like '../' that would allow writing to arbitrary locations on the filesystem."}]}
